properties.label: Hostile-target chance parameter
properties.description: The AI chance field; factions and eligibility determine whether a hostility check applies.

properties.label: Hostile-target distance parameter
properties.description: The AI distance threshold; it does not establish that this being is hostile to the player.

properties.label: Base speed parameter
properties.description: Raw speed field before state and animation-specific updates.

properties.label: Base XP award
properties.description: The creature definition's XP award; the death handler checks award eligibility and XP skills may modify the result.

properties.label: Base armor parameter
properties.description: Initializer armor parameter, not a verified total over the final HP grid.

properties.label: Declared break chance
properties.description: The definition's break threshold; the relevant action decides when to test it.

properties.label: Declared burn duration
properties.description: Initial fuel duration; the consuming action controls how it is converted to active fire time.

properties.label: Chopping capability
properties.description: The tool's chopping parameter; some recipes test it as a nonconsumed tool requirement.

properties.label: Declared comfort
properties.description: The definition's comfort value; not a direct promise of recovery per turn.

properties.label: Base crafting cost
properties.description: The recipe's declared AP cost before station and skill reductions.

properties.label: Base recipe yield
properties.description: The declared crafting yield; in-place actions such as Finish Raft are not ordinary inventory outputs.

properties.label: Cutting capability
properties.description: The tool's cutting parameter, before action-specific calculations.

properties.label: Damage class identifier
properties.description: Identifier corresponding to the game's damage-type records, not a damage amount.

properties.label: Base dodge threshold
properties.description: Declared dodge chance before combat conditions and modifiers.

properties.label: Base maximum durability
properties.description: Declared maximum durability, not the condition of an individual generated or used item.

properties.label: Declared extra damage
properties.description: Additional damage field; eligibility and application follow the relevant attack logic.

properties.label: Growth enabled in definition
properties.description: The nature initializer's growth flag; terrain, story and occupancy checks can still prevent growth.

properties.label: HP grid height
properties.description: Declared HP-grid dimension; width times height is not asserted as a verified maximum HP total.

properties.label: HP grid width
properties.description: Declared HP-grid dimension; width times height is not asserted as a verified maximum HP total.

properties.label: Idle movement threshold
properties.description: The raw movement-chance field; AI state determines when it is tested.

properties.label: Initializer value
properties.description: Literal database value before recipe postprocessing, durability and trade adjustments; not a guaranteed merchant price.

properties.label: Initializer weight
properties.description: Literal weight before the recipe postprocessing pass and runtime modifiers.

properties.label: Insulation parameter
properties.description: The declared insulation parameter, before equipment and environmental effects.

properties.label: Base item action cost
properties.description: The initializer's general item action-cost field; particular actions and skills may use or modify it differently.

properties.label: Declared armor
properties.description: Armor field on the item definition; placement and combat rules determine its effect.

properties.label: Declared light radius
properties.description: The initial light-radius parameter before runtime light updates.

properties.label: Base action-point maximum
properties.description: The maximum declared in the being definition before runtime state changes.

properties.label: Base melee attack cost
properties.description: Declared melee attack AP expenditure before runtime modifiers.

properties.label: Melee reach parameter
properties.description: The declared melee-range parameter, interpreted by the targeting code.

properties.label: Melee pattern total maximum
properties.description: Sum of encoded positive pattern cells, before target overlap, armor and modifiers; not guaranteed actual damage per attack.

properties.label: Melee pattern total minimum
properties.description: Sum of encoded positive pattern cells, before target overlap, armor and modifiers; not guaranteed actual damage per attack.

properties.label: Opportunity attack threshold
properties.description: Declared opportunity-attack chance; triggering movement and combat conditions still apply.

properties.label: Excluded from general random treasure
properties.description: This explicit flag is checked by general treasure generation; it does not rule out other acquisition paths.

properties.label: Base ranged attack cost
properties.description: Declared ranged attack AP expenditure before runtime modifiers.

properties.label: Ranged damage class identifier
properties.description: Identifier of the ranged attack's damage type, not its damage amount.

properties.label: Ranged reach parameter
properties.description: Raw ranged-distance field; nonpositive sentinel values are not usable attack ranges.

properties.label: Ranged pattern total maximum
properties.description: Sum of encoded positive pattern cells, before target overlap, armor and modifiers; not guaranteed actual damage per attack.

properties.label: Ranged pattern total minimum
properties.description: Sum of encoded positive pattern cells, before target overlap, armor and modifiers; not guaranteed actual damage per attack.

properties.label: Base satiation gain
properties.description: The food's unmodified satiation contribution.

properties.label: Base sickness risk
properties.description: Declared risk before eligibility checks or runtime modifiers.

properties.label: Declared spark chance
properties.description: An ignition component, not the overall chance to light a fire.

properties.label: Base stack limit
properties.description: Maximum stack count declared by the initializer.

properties.label: Stone spark parameter
properties.description: The alternate ignition parameter used with stone; other ignition prerequisites remain relevant.

properties.label: Literal maximum terrain-height parameter
properties.description: Included only when the initializer supplies a literal; this is not a geographic map coordinate.

properties.label: Literal minimum terrain-height parameter
properties.description: Included only when the initializer supplies a literal; expression-based thresholds are not guessed.

properties.label: Tile movement speed parameter
properties.description: Raw movement parameter, not real-world speed or a guaranteed AP cost.

properties.label: Tinder contribution
properties.description: The item's additive tinder parameter, not a standalone fire-start probability.

properties.label: Waterproofing parameter
properties.description: The declared waterproofing parameter used by wetness and drying logic.

properties.label: Equip cost
properties.description: Base equipment action cost from the item's inventory footprint, distinct from attacking or using the item.
